title: GeoSurge: Geometry-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning for Auditable Liver Resection Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32657v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Surgical resection planning centers on generating executable resection surfaces from anatomical evidence and operative constraints. Medical multimodal foundation models enable anatomical understanding, and segmentation models predict resection regions, but neither translates these capabilities into explicitly constrained, executable resection surfaces. We present GeoSurge, an anatomy-grounded framework that combines mask-derived metrics with structure-aware point-cloud tokens to generate executable, editable resection surfaces. To make resection geometry learnable and editable, GeoSurge maps actions to parametric geometry through a surface-action grammar. Using this grammar, anatomy-oriented and tumor-centered templates generate candidates, which are filtered by hard constraints and semantic deduplication. Training supervision is then derived from candidate-expert geometric agreement and independently recomputed feasibility metrics. At i

translated_title: GeoSurge：面向可审计肝切除术规划的基于几何的多模态推理
translated_abstract: 手术切除规划的核心在于从解剖学证据和手术操作约束出发，生成可执行的切除面。医学多模态基础模型能够实现解剖学理解，分割模型可以预测切除区域，但二者都无法将这些能力转化为显式约束、可执行的切除面。我们提出了 GeoSurge，这是一个以解剖学为基础的框架，它将掩码派生的度量指标与结构感知的点云标记相结合，以生成可执行且可编辑的切除面。为了使切除几何形状可学习、可编辑，GeoSurge 通过一种“面-动作”语法将动作映射为参数化几何。利用该语法，面向解剖结构的模板和以肿瘤为中心的模板生成候选切除面，再通过硬约束和语义去重进行筛选。随后，训练监督信号由候选方案与专家方案的几何一致性以及独立重新计算的可行性度量推导得出。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: GeoSurge 提出了一个以解剖学为基础的框架，通过面-动作语法将动作映射为参数化几何，并结合掩码度量与结构感知的点云标记，生成可执行、可编辑且可审计的肝切除面。
en_tdlr: GeoSurge is an anatomy-grounded framework that maps actions to parametric geometry via a surface-action grammar, combining mask-derived metrics with structure-aware point-cloud tokens to generate executable, editable, and auditable liver resection surfaces.
